acceptance.assertion: Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, protected heimgewebe/bureau main is freshly observed; the exact target contains this authority's protected publication merge, registered main c2acfd85969374b5a81c8be3a23ecbf738bf85e4 and all then-current legitimate protected-main merges, and validate (3.10), validate (3.12), registry-registration-preflight/freshness, and main-push-revalidation are successful for the exact target.

Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, active deployment-manifest source_commit and canonical Registry source identity are equal, and that active source is exactly registered source fbc4b84d6f1cd77b7b065bd0e7616c07a666a5b2 or a later verified Git ancestor of the freshly selected target main. Any identity mismatch, divergence, unavailable ancestry proof or target drift blocks the runtime effect fail-closed.

This authority starts at most one runtime effect. Failed, unclear, timeout or transport-ambiguous outcomes are read back from intent, attempt/result, manifest, launcher, package, snapshot and authority-consumption evidence before any further action; no blind retry is permitted.

After a successful refresh, deployment manifest, immutable release, package tree, launcher pair and canonical Registry snapshot bind the same freshly observed source commit, and Bureau runtime identity is integrity-valid at that exact target.

The authority is consumed exactly once after successful immutable readback and grants only Bureau runtime/Registry convergence. After terminal closeout and lease release, normal reviewed Bureau pickup may be retried against the converged runtime. This runtime authority grants no queue, claim, dispatch, task-supply, product-code, foreign-work or general repository mutation authority.

approval.note: Publication, missing-only adoption and proof-bearing activation are preparation only. No Bureau runtime effect is authorized by this TaskSpec publication or by any historical approval. Runtime mutation requires a fresh explicit user break-glass approval bound to this exact successor and the exact freshly derived post-publication target SHA256. No blind retry is permitted after any effect-started, timeout, transport-ambiguous or unclear result.

goal: Provide exactly one initially planned, executor-compatible, single-use Bureau runtime-refresh successor after protected PR #2272 advanced Bureau main beyond the integrity-valid deployed runtime. Its sole purpose is to restore Bureau runtime/canonical-Registry identity so normal reviewed Bureau pickup can resume. This authority grants no queue, claim, dispatch, task-supply, product-code, foreign-work or general repository mutation authority.
